project.name: Kurrajong Apartments balcony waterproofing, 41 Kurrajong Parade
project.summary: The owners corporation of a fully occupied 6-storey, 42-unit Class 2 strata building in Hurstville, constructed in 1986 and out of warranty, renews the waterproofing of all 42 leaking balconies like for like. The asbestos register lists fibre cement soffits, so a hazmat consultant surveys the build-ups before strip-out; the remedial building consultant tenders one AS 4000 lump sum contract, exempt from consent.

documents.content: The remedial building consultant's report after visual inspection, leak mapping, flood tests and opening-up at four representative balconies. Sections: ## Building description (existing building constructed in 1986, Class 2, rise in storeys 6, 42 apartments, no podium and no basement, pitched metal roof outside the scope), ## Findings (membrane stops short of the door sills though set-down is adequate at all thresholds and door frames are retained; reversed falls; outlets with no puddle flange and no overflow; balustrade posts core-drilled through the membrane; tiles bonded to the membrane; the common property asbestos register lists bonded fibre cement in the balcony soffits; the original bituminous membrane and mastic sealants are of unknown composition, so a hazardous materials survey of the build-ups is needed before strip-out; no spalling, cracking or exposed reinforcement on any balcony; no plant or services on the balconies), ## Options (A patch repair, B full renewal like for like, recommended), ## Recommended budget (a construction budget of $1,680,000 ex GST for Option B), ## Approvals (exempt; DBP Act applies; not a heritage item), ## Warranty (the building is out of warranty and no claim is being pursued), ## Next steps (all work from within the balconies, no external access equipment; one continuous stage).
